findings.description: `self.md.toc_tokens` is assigned `toc_tokens` before filtering out `notoc` headings, so `md.toc_tokens` still includes `notoc` headings unlike the TOC HTML output.

requirements.requirement: Skip headings with class notoc in table of contents
It would be nice if md.toc_tokens left it out too, so other tools see the same list.

summary: The pull request implements skipping headings with the class `notoc` for the generated TOC HTML, but leaves them in `md.toc_tokens` because `self.md.toc_tokens = toc_tokens` assigns the unfiltered `toc_tokens` instead of `visible`.
